title: The Independent state on the coast
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：independent　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 independent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the warden wrote of ① an independent state on the coast in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② more independent than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the independent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most independent state on the coast anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too independent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the independent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an independent mind of the girl, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as independent as the mind of the girl they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was independent or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something independent, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite independent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the independent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, for the whole place, she wrote of another independent state on the coast in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more independent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most independent mind of the girl in the whole centre, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the independent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 独立（前置定语 an independent state on the coast：1964 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件独立的国家）
B. adj. 独立／自主（比较级 more independent than：文中两处，一处比海岸上独立的国家，一处比预想）
C. adj. 独立／自主（最高级 the most independent：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 独立（表语 too independent to do：母亲觉得它太独立，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 自主（前置定语 an independent mind of the girl：叔叔把整件事称作一桩自主的思想）
F. adj. 自主（同级比较 as independent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩女孩独立的思想相比）
G. adj. 自主（后置定语 something independent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 自主（受程度副词修饰 quite independent：那位居民的评价）

items.q: an independent state on the coast
the most independent state on the coast anybody
an independent mind of the girl
The most independent mind of the girl in

answers.why: independent 意为“独立”，1964 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件独立的国家”，此处作前置定语 an independent state on the coast。
independent 意为“独立”，此处用比较级 more independent than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
independent 意为“独立”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最独立的一件，故用最高级 the most independent state on the coast。
independent 意为“独立”，母亲认为这件东西“太独立了，谁也用不上”，too independent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
independent 意为“自主”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩自主的思想”，此处作前置定语 an independent mind of the girl。
independent 意为“自主”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩女孩独立的思想一样自主”，同级比较用 as independent as。
independent 意为“自主”，登记册上那半行字要的是“自主的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something independent。
independent 意为“自主”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当自主”，quite 修饰原级 independent。
independent 意为“自主”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要自主”，故用比较级 more independent than。
independent 意为“自主”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个社区中心里最自主的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most independent mind of the girl。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件独立的国家。（an independent state on the coast）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更独立。（more independent than …）
母亲觉得它太独立，谁也用不上。（too independent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩自主的思想。（an independent mind of the girl）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩女孩独立的思想一样自主。（as independent as …）
到了 1971 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件自主的东西。（something independent）
answers: In 1964 the warden wrote of an independent state on the coast in the register.
Everybody said it was more independent than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too independent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an independent mind of the girl.
He said nobody would call it as independent as the mind of the girl they had once had.
By 1971 the register asked for nothing but something independent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 independent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the warden wrote of an independent state on the coast in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most independent state on the coast in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too independent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an independent mind of the girl, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite independent, and everybody laughed.
The independent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
